registry.description: Wisdom is the capacity to live rightly in the world — to see what is true, choose what is good, and act in a way that fits with how things actually are. The Hebrew vocabulary (chokhmah, binah, sakal) covers both the practical skill of living and the deeper understanding that comes from knowing God. Wisdom begins with the fear of the Lord: the properly ordered relationship with God that makes genuine perception and right action possible. God himself is described as wise; human wisdom is a participation in and reflection of his.
